publication_note: Reviewed from an October 9, 2026 supplied capture of CAIR Action’s official Explore page. The page could not be independently re-fetched. The capture omits the selected-election header, so the recommendation’s election phase is unspecified.
retrieval_limits: The live Explore page was inaccessible. The browser PDF reader rejected the 48.9 MB PDF; a direct download returned HTTP 403. The PDF was not read or used to assign recommendation labels or election phase.
